QUICKSTART

Connect your application

Use your application ID and a customer license key. Activation binds the license to the first device fingerprint that uses it.

POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/activate\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{\n  "app_id": "your-application",\n  "license_key": "LIC-...",\n  "device_id": "your-stable-device-id",\n  "device_label": "Design workstation"\n}
POST · /v1/activate

Activate a license

The first successful activation grants access and returns a signed token. Repeating activation on the same device is safe; another device is rejected.

{\n  "ok": true,\n  "token": "signed-license-token",\n  "status": "active"\n}
POST · /v1/validate

Validate a token

Call validation when your application starts or when it needs to confirm current access.

{\n  "app_id": "your-application",\n  "token": "signed-license-token",\n  "device_id": "your-stable-device-id"\n}
MANAGEMENT

Manage licenses

Developer and admin dashboards can create, list, reset, and revoke licenses. Management routes require the correct developer session or API key.

POST /v1/developer/licensesCreate a license
GET /v1/developer/licensesList your licenses
POST /v1/licenses/{key}/resetReset a device binding
POST /v1/licenses/{key}/revokeRevoke access
ERRORS

Predictable responses

Errors use a stable JSON shape with a machine-readable code and a human-readable message.

{\n  "error": {\n    "code": "LICENSE_BOUND",\n    "message": "This license is already bound to another device."\n  }\n}
